event_description: First participating observation by PostHog; migrated instances are labelled.
First authenticated UI opening per backend process, after acknowledgement.
First effective activity of a new participating instance.
First effective user activity per UTC day; use unique instances for DAU.
First activity per feature per UTC day; measures reach.
Qualified read, changed chapter save, admitted run or completed explicit action; split by operation and trigger.
One successful ended execution, paired with feature_used operation=run by run_id.
One failed execution with a fixed structured error category; no raw error text.
Cancelled, suspended or preempted execution; not a success or failure.
First successful user execution or changed chapter save per feature; a technical value proxy.
First successful user-originated work per feature per UTC date.
Successful book creation, book export or project version restore.
Successfully changed effective theme or language; no arbitrary settings values.
Fixed frontend error kind, registered authenticated HTTP error or recovered API panic; not a hard-crash counter.
